subject.title: [Bug]: Agent reads workspace files after tool discovery, causing timeouts on natural language queries

question: Should slow local-model first turns change the default policy so workspace bootstrap guidance is prioritized over Tool Search discovery, or should the current Tool Search default remain with docs/config guidance?
rationale: Current main intentionally does both: injects bootstrap files and exposes Tool Search for lean local-model runs, so changing the default affects prompt size, tool discoverability, and local-model support policy.

options.title: Require live repro before changing policy
options.body: Keep this issue open under maintainer review and run Nemotron/vLLM proof before deciding whether runtime defaults should change.

options.title: Adopt a workspace-first local-model policy
options.body: Change embedded runs so TOOLS.md/SOUL.md or a small derived summary steers first-turn tool choice before Tool Search can dominate, with regression tests and docs.

options.title: Document current behavior as intentional
options.body: Keep Tool Search defaults and point slow backends to tools.toolSearch:false or compat.supportsTools:false, then close only after documenting the supported workaround.

recommendation.title: Require live repro before changing policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open under maintainer review and run Nemotron/vLLM proof before deciding whether runtime defaults should change.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent changes put Vincent closest to the embedded runner, local-model lean defaults, and prompt surface that would need the policy change.
